text:
Maya: Heads-up — Nautilus AI slipped into low-touch churn zone. Health 39%. They stopped after initial POC; renewal in 28 days. Proposing a 10-day "reignite + soft-downgrade" play: re-engage with micro-enable, and map a downgrade-safe path if they don't take it. Thoughts?
Arjun: Sounds good. Want to verify if billing or auth dropped first? CS Bot: [alert] Nautilus AI — ingestion errors down 60%, auth.errors 2. last_activity 2025-06-07.
Felix: I can run a 10-day micro-course: 3 micro-tours (ingest, embeddings, search), 1 office hour, and a checklist. Also prep a targeted ROI note showing query reduction -> cost improvement.
Maya: For downgrade path we should offer: 1) move to Starter tier (keeps core APIs + limited throughput), 2) preserved embeddings retention for 30 days, 3) optional 1-hr SE workshop. Keep it safe so they don't churn.
Arjun: Ops: prefer a conditional credit only if they re-engage. If downgrade is chosen, flag for finance to avoid automatic prorate.
June: I'll draft the kickoff email and the checklist. Checklist items: SDK test ping, 100 embeds indexed, 20 semantic queries, attend office hour.
Omar: I'll build a short ROI doc comparing current token spend vs projected Starter tier spend. ETA 24h.
Maya: Escalation plan: if no checklist progress by day 7 -> open SE deep-dive and offer a 60-min workshop. If still no lift by day 12 -> renewal outreach + downgrade offer.
Felix: I'll ship the tours and hook `onboarding.step` events to the CS dashboard. ETA 36h.
CS Bot: [metric] Nautilus engagement: onboarding.step=0 -> 180 in 48h after tour deploy. Early signal good.
Maya: Assignments: Felix (tours + events), June (emails + checklist), Omar (ROI), Arjun (ops/credit guardrails), Maya (renewals coord). I'll ping the account now and paste replies here.
June: Draft email (short):
```
Subject: Quick 10-day re-ignite for Nautilus AI
Hi — we noticed activity dropped after POC. Want to run a short 10-day reboot: micro-tours, office hour, quick checklist. If you hit milestones we can apply a small contingent credit. Otherwise, we can discuss a Starter tier that preserves your data. Available for a 15-min kickoff?
```
Maya: Thanks all. Keep updates here; prefer low-friction saves first. :rocket:
